name: supaflow
description: Build, run, monitor, and troubleshoot data pipelines with Supaflow.

interface.longDescription: Build and run data pipelines directly in ChatGPT. Move data across SaaS apps, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes. Transform data using dbt Core™ models and sync data to your business apps with reverse ETL. Orchestrate pipelines, manage schedules, and troubleshoot issues—all through conversation.
